abilities.effect: The memory of Osoyo unleashes a tremendous sigh of freezing wind, coating the deck of the Mermaid’s Tears in ice in a 60-foot cone. (The hazard can choose any point for the cone to originate.) The area becomes difficult terrain. Creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude save or take 1d6 persistent cold damage as the freezing wind cuts to the bone. The hazard then rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Event 15

hazard.description: The party’s memories of Osoyo coalesce into a titanic mirage in the storm clouds above.
hazard.disable: DC 22 Occultism (trained) or DC 24 Arcana (trained) to divert the memory’s rage; three total successful checks are required to disable the hazard
hazard.name: Memory of Osoyo
hazard.routine: (1 action) The memory of Osoyo gives a keening scream that shatters the layer of ice coating the deck of the Mermaid’s Tears. Any creature on difficult terrain created by the memory’s Glacial Gust takes 2d8+7 cold damage (DC 26 basic Reflex save) from the icy shrapnel.

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Environmental
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is something dangerous that’s part of the natural world, such as quicksand or harmful mold.

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.
